spec_match.rationale: The modern classifier switches over the exact three GamepadButtonType enum values and surfaces any other value verbatim as unknown:<value>; the legacy column reproduces the id-sniffing world the attribute replaces.

interactive.rationale: Classify-my-pad runs both classifiers over real navigator.getGamepads() data; four labelled sample snapshots exercise the same code paths, rendering input and per-button diff tables plus a computed verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises a side-by-side diff with forward-compat handling and degrade-only-when-absent; the page delivers each, including the unknown-enum sample.

edge_cases.rationale: Dedicated coverage of attribute-absent (agreement-by-fallback marked per row, distinct verdict), no-trackpad pads, unknown future enum values (never bucketed), and no-gamepad (honest prerequisite message).

references.rationale: See-also links the spec enum anchor and the ChromeStatus entry.

conformance.rationale: The enum-vocabulary contract this page teaches is pinned by the feature suite's type-values-within-enum manual assertion and the honest prototype probes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven Chrome 141 run exercised the no-gamepad fallback and all four samples: dualsense-with-type 0 diff/18 agree, dualsense-no-type all-absent verdict with 0 false diffs (a real agreement-logic bug found and fixed during this pass), xbox 0/17, future-enum 2 diffs with the forward-compat verdict; screenshot interact-mapping-migration.png, console clean. Simulated samples are labelled SIMULATED SAMPLE in the results line.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts mapping-migration-classified with source/diff/unknown counts after every classification and mapping-migration-no-gamepad-fallback on the fallback branch.

design_system.rationale: Diff/agree tints are color-mix over paper with black text; REAL vs SIMULATED tags use emerald/rose on ivory text (AA); select and buttons override background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select, native buttons with focus-visible outlines, verdict in a role=status live region, both tables have captions and scoped headers, agree/DIFF is conveyed as text as well as tint.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check desktop OK clean, mobile OK: both result tables scroll in their own overflow-x containers and the before/after code columns collapse at 900px.

openQuestions.title: Diff the classifiers against a real pad once type ships
openQuestions.detail: On a CL-7760763 build with the flag, run 'Classify my connected pad' with a DualSense and with a non-Sony pad exposing extra buttons (e.g. Elite paddles): the DualSense should agree with the legacy table while the paddles produce genuine DIFF rows (non-standard vs unclassified), which no simulated sample can prove.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table small screens no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep wide tables scrolling inside their own containers and collapse multi-column layouts on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .result-scroll { overflow-x: auto } around both tables plus 760px/900px single-column collapses keep the 360px viewport overflow-free (responsive-check mobile OK).

guidanceConsulted.query: communicating table diff state accessibly not by colour alone
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair colour coding with text and expose outcomes through live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each diff cell carries the literal text 'yes'/'DIFF' in addition to tint, and the verdict paragraph is role=status aria-live=polite.

summary: Migration and edge-case page diffing the legacy id-sniffing classifier against the type attribute. Fully exercised headlessly on Chrome 141 including all four labelled simulated samples and the no-gamepad fallback; a false-diff bug in the agreement logic was caught by this verification and fixed before ship.
